verdict.rationale: Vercel's Support Terms publish a severity-based target response-time table for the Enterprise Standard and Premium support tiers, for example Severity 1 at under 4 business hours (Standard) or under 2 hours, 24/7 (Premium). However, these are 'target' guidelines rather than guaranteed SLAs, and Vercel states it only commits to respond to Enterprise customers, so Hobby and Pro tiers have no response-time commitment. Missing for 10: response-time commitments for non-Enterprise plans, documented escalation paths, contractually guaranteed (not target) response times, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the guaranteed support response times and escalation paths for my plan tier
